where: site records: Existing exact trap/service/function and criticality/failure consequence, source/current list and associations, current inspection/test/monitor/report/repair/verification program, method/interval/result and responsible response coverage.

a walkdown: Only if applicable questions remain after existing-record review, agree safe additional observations with the responsible specialist; no mandatory live test, sampling, shutdown, tuning, instrument or equipment change.
data_requests.how: A TRAP name is not established steam service or failure, and generic UT or another trap's monitor does not settle this record. S3 completepp1-2 calls for systematic inspection/testing/repair and considers online monitoring for important traps/processes; it describes different methods and contextual intervals, not a universal mandate. S19 printed40-42 presents automatic monitoring in conjunction with regular maintenance. Review suitable existing program and consequences first, acknowledging effective records or nonapplicability without obligatory new online hardware or survey. Foreign/old/unavailable and blank records remain explicit.

questions.decision_rule: Review actual steam-trap service, importance, existing maintenance/inspection/monitor and response/verification coverage with the responsible specialist. Neither a global monitor label nor a criticality name establishes coverage, failure or a need for online monitoring. Suitable existing strategy or nonapplicability can be acknowledged; unresolved records remain a question, not an inspection/repair instruction or transferred source benefit.

typical_benefit.wording: LBNL (as reported in LBNL-56183): "Automatic Steam Trap Monitoring 5%", 1 yr. DOE tip sheet: "Consider online monitoring of the most important steam traps".
source_titles: S19: Worrell & Galitsky, Energy Efficiency Improvement and Cost Saving Opportunities for Petroleum Refineries: An ENERGY STAR Guide (LBNL-56183, Feb 2005)
S3: Steam Tip #1, Inspect and Repair Steam Traps (DOE/GO-102012-3401)
S24: DOE IAC/ITAC database: browse pages, download, schema document

questions.limits: Source review: complete S3 SteamTip1 pp1-2 and S19 originalLBNL printed40-42/PDF48-50. Historical additional5% estimate is relative to regular maintenance and based on secondary reports, with contextual payback assumptions; it is not installed failure or a site benefit. UT may be an unrelated ultrasonic measurement; type/source/purpose/coverage must be reviewed. No generic-analyzer suppression or current monitoring authority is inferred.
